# network_plugin.txt — Amino Acid Custom Network (Plugin version)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# This is a drop-in replacement for amino/network.txt that uses the
# custom_network plugin instead of --network_type=fully_connected.
#
# The architecture is IDENTICAL to network.txt:
#   raw string → TextVectorization → Embedding → Flatten → FC stack → output
#
# The only difference is that the network is defined in network_plugin_fc.py
# rather than being auto-generated by Zero2Neuro.
#
# Usage:
#   cd zero2neuro/src
#   python zero2neuro.py @../examples/amino/data.txt
#                        @../examples/amino/experiment.txt
#                        @../examples/amino/network_plugin.txt -vvv --force

--network_type
plugin

###
# Input / Output
# String input: one string (amino acid sequence) per example
--input_shape
1

--output_shape
1

# elup1 = elu(x) + 1 — keeps binding affinity prediction strictly positive
--output_activation=elup1

###
# Hidden layers — same as amino/network.txt
--number_hidden_units
200
100
50
25
10

--hidden_activation=elu

###
# Regularization — same as amino/network.txt
--dropout=0.25
--l2=0.0001

###
# Tokenizer (char-level, same settings as data.txt / network.txt)
# These are the same flags that the built-in network types use.
--tokenizer
--tokenizer_max_tokens=24
--tokenizer_split=character
--tokenizer_output_sequence_length=30

# Embedding: each token integer → 15-dimensional learned vector
--embedding
--embedding_dimensions=15

###
# Plugin registration
# Only network_file goes here.
# All hyperparameters are above, as standard flags.
--plugin_list
custom_network_builder, network_file=network_plugin_cnn.py
